expected.finding: **[P1]** Raw trace excerpts can publish credentials in policy PRs. [revise-improvement-policy.py:318](/home/runner/work/open-inspect-72e95a/open-inspect-72e95a/scripts/revise-improvement-policy.py:318) copies failure text into topic evidence, which becomes `mined_from` in both committed policy files. The workflow also prints excerpts to logs. A synthetic failure containing `postgres://admin:[REDACTED]@…` preserved the password in both the report and proposed policy. Store sanitized evidence references and redact sensitive content before logging or mining it; review before merging cannot protect secrets already pushed.

**[P2]** Failure deduplication discards evidence from distinct errors. [mine-trace-failures.py:255](/home/runner/work/open-inspect-72e95a/open-inspect-72e95a/scripts/mine-trace-failures.py:255) identifies failures using truncated commands and excerpts, then retains only the first failure’s full text. Two executions with identical headers but different later diagnostics collapse together. Reproduction showed a later credential exposure disappearing from the evidence entirely, potentially producing incorrect policy discounts. Deduplicate using the complete command and output, or preserve every occurrence’s topic matches.
